title: Introduce orchestrated backfill-aware evictor and page-mending handoff
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: KV cache fragmentation and uncontrolled spillover during tenant backfills were causing multi-tenant tail latency spikes and elevated egress to cold storage. This PR introduces a coordinated backfill-aware evictor and a lightweight page-mending handoff protocol that reduces fragmentation and smooths spillback during sustained background writes. Summary of changes: 1) evictor: new gradient-based eviction policy that weights fragmentation score, tenant priority, and backfill intensity; 2) backfill coordinator: exposes a soft-lock contract so long-running backfills advertise working sets and receive eviction leeway; 3) handoff protocol: compacting swaps and page-mend operations that attempt in-place remerge before spill-to-disk; 4) scheduler hooks: add preemption-safe window for continuous-batching to drain KV write bursts without defeating latency SLOs; 5) metrics and knobs: new metrics kv.backfill_score, kv.fragmentation_ratio, kv.handoff_attempts and associated config for backfill_throttle and mend_retries. Implementation notes: eviction policy implemented in runtime/kv/evictor with a small state machine and async io-safe recovery path; backfill coordinator runs in a per-tenant actor and negotiates with evictor via shared SI queues; handoff uses preallocated temporary pages to avoid allocation stalls. Testing and validation: unit tests for eviction heuristics and handoff correctness; end-to-end bench harness that runs mixed load with synthetic backfills to measure tail-latency and spill volume; staged rollout to Dedicated with canary and automatic rollback on >5% tail-latency regression. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (ENG-2145) [x] unit tests added [x] bench added [x] docs/ops updated [x] feature-flag guarded and on-by-default in canary. Risks: handoff retries can increase short-term CPU; mitigated by exponential backoff + mend_retries cap. Rollout plan: deploy to canary cluster for 72 hours, analyze kv.handoff_attempts and kv.spill_bytes, then enable global rollout if spill volume drops >40% and p99 latency unchanged or improved. Related: references to prior compaction PRs for allocator stability.

feat(kv): implement page-mend handoff with in-place compaction attempt
docs(ops): describe backfill knobs and rollout guidance
fix(scheduler): ensure batching window preemption is safe during handoff
review_comments: Tomás Alvarez: Please add a short doc comment on the eviction weight formula and how tenant priority interacts with fragmentation score. Author reply: Added comment and unit test that validates weight ordering under synthetic conditions.
Priya Nair: Can mend_retries be made configurable per-tenant? Concern about noisy tenants. Author reply: Added per-tenant override and default global cap; updated config surface in docs.

Evan Li: Benchmark shows 2% CPU increase at 95th; can we gate CPU-heavy compaction to low-load windows? Author reply: Added low-load gating heuristic and adaptive backoff; re-ran bench and p99 tail improved while CPU delta reduced to 0.4%.
Alex (SRE): Confirmed metrics emitted and alert threshold suggestions; requested a transient spike window in runbook. Author reply: Runbook updated and added canary dashboard tiles.
ci_checks: bench-suite: pass with warning (initial run showed 2% CPU; fixed)
release_notes: Introduce backfill-aware eviction and page-mend handoff to reduce KV spillover during tenant backfills. Adds new metrics and knobs for ops tuning. Improves p99 under mixed backfill workloads.
discussion_summary: Consensus reached that a coordinated backfill contract is preferable to unilateral eviction tuning. SRE requested runbook updates and thresholds. Implementation favors incremental rollout behind config flags. Bench improvements validated after adaptive gating added.
testing_summary: Unit tests covering eviction weight ordering and mend success rates, integration mixed-backfill harness demonstrating 45% drop in spill bytes and 8% improvement in p99 under test load, and canary run with no degraded SLOs over 72h.
notes_for_ops: Feature is behind feature flag 'kv.backfill_handoff_v1'. Default canary config: backfill_throttle=0.25, mend_retries=3, low_load_window_ms=2000. Watch kv.spill_bytes, kv.handoff_attempts, kv.fragmentation_ratio. Rollback if p99 increases >5% or spill_bytes increases.
